_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Hunter's Calling#000.src: Explore the deepest part of the Silent Expanse
A Hunter's Calling#000.dst: 探索寂静荒原的最深处

A Hunter's Calling#002.src: ...you arrive. You search... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#002.dst: ……你来了。你在寻找……为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#003.src: You wonder. What do we speak of? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#003.dst: 你在疑惑。我们在说什么？为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#004.src: You panic. We know you. How? We can provide no answer.
A Hunter's Calling#004.dst: 你在惊慌。我们认识你。怎么会？我们给不出答案。

A Hunter's Calling#005.src: For answers... You search. To an end you seek. May we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#005.dst: 为了答案……你在寻找。你寻求一个终结。我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#006.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.
A Hunter's Calling#006.dst: 被围困的起源。要终结，就必须先开始。

A Hunter's Calling#007.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.
A Hunter's Calling#007.dst: 被围困的起源。要终结，就必须先开始。

A Hunter's Calling#009.src: You anger. Viewing needless destruction. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#009.dst: 你在愤怒。目睹无谓的毁灭。为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#010.src: You distrust. We are dark. Are we? You believe it so.
A Hunter's Calling#010.dst: 你不信任。我们是黑暗的。是吗？你认为如此。

A Hunter's Calling#011.src: You prepare. You would attack us. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#011.dst: 你在准备。你想攻击我们。为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: There is no end. Of what you wish, there is none. But may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#012.dst: 没有终结。你所希望的，并不存在。但我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#013.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#013.dst: 不义之人寻求它。高尚之人藏起它。寻求答案之人找到了更多疑问。另一个开始……通往新的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#014.dst: 不义之人寻求它。高尚之人藏起它。寻求答案之人找到了更多疑问。另一个开始……通往新的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: Hey, little miss. Don't go spacing out on me like that.
A Hunter's Calling#015.dst: 嘿，小姐。别在我面前发呆。
A Hunter's Calling#015.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: Now that you're acquainted with the new laws we'll want to introduce, I've got a job for you to do.
A Hunter's Calling#016.dst: 既然你已经了解我们打算推行的新法律，我有份工作要交给你。
A Hunter's Calling#016.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: The current mayor is human. He'll inevitably veto the laws. The deputy on the other hand, is a villager, and on our side. See what I'm getting at.
A Hunter's Calling#017.dst: 现任镇长是人类。他一定会否决那些法律。副镇长就不一样了，他是村民，而且站在我们这边。你明白我的意思吧。
A Hunter's Calling#017.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#018.src: Another employee has already been sent out to get things started. He'll know what you need to do, so meet up with him, would you?
A Hunter's Calling#018.dst: 另一位员工已经先派出去开始行动了。他会知道你该做什么，去跟他会合吧？
A Hunter's Calling#018.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#019.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee at {~}, {~}.
A Hunter's Calling#019.dst: 前往镇上，在 {~}, {~} 向员工打听进一步的情报。

A Hunter's Calling#020.src: Oh, yeah I saw the mayor not too long ago.
A Hunter's Calling#020.dst: 噢，对，我不久前才看到镇长。
A Hunter's Calling#020.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: He was headed towards the bank. Why're you wondering, miss Villager?
A Hunter's Calling#021.dst: 他往银行那边去了。你问这个干嘛，村民小姐？
A Hunter's Calling#021.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#022.src: You are here for the job, aren't you? I have to apologize. It's gonna be trickier than I'd wanted for you.
A Hunter's Calling#022.dst: 你是来接这份工作的，对吧？我得先道个歉。这事会比我原本希望的还要棘手。
A Hunter's Calling#022.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#023.src: So our mission is to assassinate the mayor. Amadel told you about the laws. We have a puppet in the running who'll rubberstamp them.
A Hunter's Calling#023.dst: 我们的任务是刺杀镇长。Amadel 跟你说过那些法律了。我们有个傀儡在竞选，他会照单全收。
A Hunter's Calling#023.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#024.src: I've got a trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#024.dst: 我在银行里设了个陷阱。实在太费劲了，不过总算弄好了。你的工作是触发陷阱。
A Hunter's Calling#024.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#025.src: Climb up the tree behind me and look through the window, you should be able to see it from there.
A Hunter's Calling#025.dst: 爬上我后面那棵树，从窗户往里看，你应该就能看到它。
A Hunter's Calling#025.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: Climb the tree and look through the window.

A Hunter's Calling#027.src: Can you see the mayor? I had to stay totally out of sight while setting this all up, so...
A Hunter's Calling#027.dst: 你看得到镇长吗？我设置这些的时候得完全躲着不被看到，所以……
A Hunter's Calling#027.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#028.src: ...the only way to get to the trap is to jump across the hanging lamps in the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#028.dst: ……唯一能到陷阱那里的方法，就是跳过天花板上的吊灯。
A Hunter's Calling#028.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#029.src: You can absolutely not be spotted. The way up to the ceiling is on the opposite side of the bank. Just keep on walking past the guards, play it cool.
A Hunter's Calling#029.dst: 你绝对不能被发现。上天花板的路在银行的另一头。只要若无其事地从守卫旁边走过去就行。
A Hunter's Calling#029.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#030.src: No one enters when the mayor is doing his errands, sorry. You'll have to wait for your transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#030.dst: 镇长办事的时候谁都不准进，抱歉。你的交易得等一等了。
A Hunter's Calling#030.speaker: Bodyguard

A Hunter's Calling#031.src: Head back to the excavation camp.

A Hunter's Calling#032.src: Quickly, back to the camp. Before we're noticed.
A Hunter's Calling#032.dst: 快，回营地去。趁我们还没被发现。
A Hunter's Calling#032.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#035.src: Yes sir, everything went smoothly. did a great thing for the company.
A Hunter's Calling#035.dst: 是的，长官，一切顺利。 为公司立了大功。
A Hunter's Calling#035.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#036.src: We can send in Miss Wuna anytime now, and she'll give us the clearance to start the excavation in a snap.
A Hunter's Calling#036.dst: 我们现在随时可以派 Wuna 小姐进去，她很快就会批准我们开始发掘。
A Hunter's Calling#036.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#038.src: ...you rage. Aided the ignoble. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#038.dst: ……你在愤怒。帮助了卑劣之人。为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#039.src: You misinterpret. What you see... Is it true? How?
A Hunter's Calling#039.dst: 你误解了。你所看见的……是真的吗？怎么会？

A Hunter's Calling#040.src: The answer... It will not bring you the end.
A Hunter's Calling#040.dst: 那个答案……不会带给你终结。

A Hunter's Calling#041.src: You see. Yet you do not understand. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#041.dst: 你看见了。却不明白。那么，我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#042.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#042.dst: 残酷的。仁慈的。自私的。公正的。那个一生在矛盾中行走的人。那个冷冷地面对永恒的人。走向他的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#043.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#043.dst: 残酷的。仁慈的。自私的。公正的。那个一生在矛盾中行走的人。那个冷冷地面对永恒的人。走向他的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#045.src: Listen, I understand the discontent, but we must start rationing! The corruption is consuming our arable fields.
A Hunter's Calling#045.dst: 听着，我理解大家的不满，但我们必须开始配给！腐化正在吞噬我们的耕地。
A Hunter's Calling#045.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#046.src: Who knows if we'll even have water soon? We need to save up as much as we can!
A Hunter's Calling#046.dst: 谁知道我们很快会不会连水都没有？我们得尽可能省下来！
A Hunter's Calling#046.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#047.src: Yeah, and what does Theorick have to say on the topic? How will he think of that?
A Hunter's Calling#047.dst: 是啊，那 Theorick 对这件事怎么说？他会怎么想？
A Hunter's Calling#047.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#048.src: He will be here shortly to discuss the topic in more detai-
A Hunter's Calling#048.dst: 他很快就会来这里，更详细地讨论这件——
A Hunter's Calling#048.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#049.src: Everyone, hush and listen to what Kotham is saying!
A Hunter's Calling#049.dst: 大家安静，听 Kotham 说！
A Hunter's Calling#049.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#050.src: As the mayor said, all of you need to start rationing what you eat and drink. I cannot be here every waking moment!
A Hunter's Calling#050.dst: 就像镇长说的，你们所有人都得开始节约吃喝。我不可能每时每刻都在这里！
A Hunter's Calling#050.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#051.src: In addition, I've figured something very important out. I'm developing a way to cease the spread of corruption. So I need to concentrate on that.
A Hunter's Calling#051.dst: 另外，我想通了一件非常重要的事。我正在研发一种阻止腐化蔓延的方法。所以我得专心在那上面。
A Hunter's Calling#051.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#053.src: ...someone among you... I can feel a horrendous strength...
A Hunter's Calling#053.dst: ……你们之中有个人……我感觉到一股可怕的力量……
A Hunter's Calling#053.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#054.src: Kotham! Get everyone to safety! NOW! MOVE, GO!
A Hunter's Calling#054.dst: Kotham！把大家带到安全的地方！马上！快走！
A Hunter's Calling#054.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#055.src: You! Sent by Bak'al, I presume? What, is he too much of a coward to face me himself?
A Hunter's Calling#055.dst: 你！我猜是 Bak'al 派来的吧？怎么，他懦弱到不敢亲自来面对我？
A Hunter's Calling#055.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#056.src: What purpose do you have for doing this? This destruction is needless! {p} and all of Wynn have suffered enough!
A Hunter's Calling#056.dst: 你这么做有什么目的？这种破坏毫无必要！{p} 和整个 Wynn 已经受够苦了！
A Hunter's Calling#056.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#057.src: I'll freeze you solid, just like the rest of the corruption, you foul THING!
A Hunter's Calling#057.dst: 我要把你冻得结结实实，就跟其他腐化一样，你这肮脏的东西！
A Hunter's Calling#057.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#059.src: This way, no one else gets hurt. Only one will leave from here alive.
A Hunter's Calling#059.dst: 这样一来，就不会有其他人受伤了。只有一个人能活着离开这里。
A Hunter's Calling#059.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#061.src: ...you fear. Does the dark become you?
A Hunter's Calling#061.dst: ……你在恐惧。黑暗是否与你相称？

A Hunter's Calling#063.src: No. You remain whole. You do not change.
A Hunter's Calling#063.dst: 不。你依然完整。你并未改变。

A Hunter's Calling#064.src: So, you wonder. To what end? The question brings dread.
A Hunter's Calling#064.dst: 所以，你在疑惑。为了什么终结？这个问题令人畏惧。

A Hunter's Calling#065.src: Yet, an end is what you seek. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#065.dst: 然而，你寻求的正是终结。那么，我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#066.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#066.dst: 一个终结，被进一步的行动推翻。一个终结，落到六人头上。一个终结，终结傲慢者的笃定。一个终结，终结世界……以某种方式。

A Hunter's Calling#067.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#067.dst: 一个终结，被进一步的行动推翻。一个终结，落到六人头上。一个终结，终结傲慢者的笃定。一个终结，终结世界……以某种方式。

A Hunter's Calling#068.src: Enter the Corrupter of World Cave
A Hunter's Calling#068.dst: 进入世界腐化者的洞穴

A Hunter's Calling#069.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.

A Hunter's Calling#070.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#070.dst: 返回洞穴上方，修好一条出路。

A Hunter's Calling#071.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#071.dst: 返回洞穴上方，修好一条出路。

A Hunter's Calling#073.src: ...you disbelieve. It was an end. But you are here once more.
A Hunter's Calling#073.dst: ……你难以置信。那是一个终结。但你又在这里了。

A Hunter's Calling#074.src: How much more? Where next? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#074.dst: 还有多少？下一个在哪？为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#075.src: Aiding terrible forces... But is it true? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#075.dst: 协助可怕的力量……但那是真的吗？为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#077.src: No. You see possibility. You do not see certainty.
A Hunter's Calling#077.dst: 不。你看见的是可能。你看不见必然。

A Hunter's Calling#078.src: You question. To what end, then, and so may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#078.dst: 你在质疑。那么，为了什么终结，所以我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#079.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#079.dst: 金属。阻止终结。生命。终结，被阻止。夺走生命、带来终结的金属，真的阻止了更多吗？

A Hunter's Calling#080.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#080.dst: 金属。阻止终结。生命。终结，被阻止。夺走生命、带来终结的金属，真的阻止了更多吗？

A Hunter's Calling#081.src: Ah, here for the job opportunity then, I see. The waiver didn't turn you away, good!
A Hunter's Calling#081.dst: 啊，看来是来应征工作的。免责书没把你吓跑，很好！
A Hunter's Calling#081.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#082.src: Now, to business. Times are tough, as you know, and our Iron Golems are in high demand. However, we've, ah...
A Hunter's Calling#082.dst: 好了，说正事。你也知道，现在时局艰难，我们的铁魔像需求量很大。不过，我们，呃……
A Hunter's Calling#082.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#083.src: ...experienced a draught of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#083.dst: ……遇到了“志愿者”短缺的问题。你的工作还算简单；就是——*咳咳*——说服一些人加入这项事业。
A Hunter's Calling#083.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#084.src: Three people should be enough for the moment. Look around the swamp for some folks, and lure them over here.
A Hunter's Calling#084.dst: 目前三个人应该就够了。在沼泽附近找找人，把他们引到这里来。
A Hunter's Calling#084.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#085.src: I'll stay in here and take care of them when you bring me them. It will absolutely be worth your while, I assure you.
A Hunter's Calling#085.dst: 我会待在这里，等你把人带来就由我来处理。我保证绝对值得你花这份力气。
A Hunter's Calling#085.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#086.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.
A Hunter's Calling#086.dst: 骗 {~} 个人跟着你进入铁魔像工厂。

A Hunter's Calling#087.src: Agh, dang it dang it dang it! You over there, help me out, would ya??
A Hunter's Calling#087.dst: 啊，该死该死该死！那边那个，帮我一下好吗？？
A Hunter's Calling#087.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#088.src: I tripped and fell in this stupid hole, and now there's mud in my eyes that I can't get out!
A Hunter's Calling#088.dst: 我绊倒摔进这个蠢洞里，现在眼睛里全是泥巴，弄都弄不出来！
A Hunter's Calling#088.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#089.src: I need to get home or to some kind of a doctor so I can wash my eyes out with actual clean water.
A Hunter's Calling#089.dst: 我得回家或是去找个医生，用真正干净的水把眼睛洗干净。
A Hunter's Calling#089.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#090.src: Get me to {p} or a doctor or even just a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#090.dst: 带我去 {p}，或者去找医生，就算只是个洗手台也好！
A Hunter's Calling#090.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#091.src: Good job! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#091.dst: 干得好！我们会好好照顾你的。
A Hunter's Calling#091.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#092.src: Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
A Hunter's Calling#092.dst: 噢，啊……嘻嘻，嗨，小可爱……你跑到这么远的地方来干嘛？
A Hunter's Calling#092.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#093.src: Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
A Hunter's Calling#093.dst: 只是在探险，是吧？我打赌像你这样的人正需要有个人……你懂的，陪你一起打发时间……
A Hunter's Calling#093.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#094.src: ...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
A Hunter's Calling#094.dst: ……看来你没兴趣？噢……如果我让你觉得不舒服，抱歉。我只是……真的很寂寞而已。
A Hunter's Calling#094.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#095.src: W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
A Hunter's Calling#095.dst: 等、等等，这些是……给我的？噢，你不必这样的，我好开心！
A Hunter's Calling#095.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#096.src: You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
A Hunter's Calling#096.dst: 你想约我出去？真、真的？你愿意给我一个机会？当然好！
A Hunter's Calling#096.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#097.src: Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
A Hunter's Calling#097.dst: 请带路吧！我等不及想知道我们要去哪了！
A Hunter's Calling#097.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#098.src: Well done! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#098.dst: 做得好！我们会好好照顾你的。
A Hunter's Calling#098.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#099.src: A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
A Hunter's Calling#099.dst: 能给个零钱吗，给一个失业的老人家？
A Hunter's Calling#099.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#100.src: This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
A Hunter's Calling#100.dst: 这衰败让我病得很重。我还有一家人要养……多少都有帮助。
A Hunter's Calling#100.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#101.src: I'll take care of this homeless old man.
A Hunter's Calling#101.dst: 这个无家可归的老头就交给我处理吧。
A Hunter's Calling#101.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#102.src: Good job, let us get down to my lab.
A Hunter's Calling#102.dst: 干得好，我们下去我的实验室吧。
A Hunter's Calling#102.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#103.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#104.src: Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
A Hunter's Calling#104.dst: 完美的工作！我敢说这是我们迄今最好的一批，全都要感谢你。
A Hunter's Calling#104.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#105.src: Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here.Examine the fruits of your labour.
A Hunter's Calling#105.dst: 来，走近一点！你在这里提供了出色的服务。好好看看你的劳动成果吧。
A Hunter's Calling#105.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#106.src: Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
A Hunter's Calling#106.dst: 看着它们的眼睛，简直就像能看到它们曾经是什么样的人。真有意思，不是——
A Hunter's Calling#106.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#107.src: Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
A Hunter's Calling#107.dst: 哈！这只好像挺喜欢你的！要不要当作额外报酬带回家？
A Hunter's Calling#107.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#109.src: ...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.
A Hunter's Calling#109.dst: ……你放弃了。你认为自己永远找不到你所寻求的答案。

A Hunter's Calling#110.src: You see the ends... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#110.dst: 你看见了那些终结……为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#111.src: They are not yours. What is their purpose?
A Hunter's Calling#111.dst: 那些不是你的。它们的目的是什么？

A Hunter's Calling#112.src: You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#112.dst: 你不明白。但你必须看见。那么，我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#113.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#113.dst: 家园，被入侵。社会，在崩塌。人民，在挨饿。忧心之人，无能为力。火焰，正在升起。一个你意想不到的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#114.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#114.dst: 家园，被入侵。社会，在崩塌。人民，在挨饿。忧心之人，无能为力。火焰，正在升起。一个你意想不到的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#115.src: Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
A Hunter's Calling#115.dst: 我们的国王下令清除贫民窟的人。
A Hunter's Calling#115.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#116.src: He wants to clean up their tunnels and build more residences. Please, go tell those hooligans to get out of our city.
A Hunter's Calling#116.dst: 他想清理掉他们的隧道，盖更多住宅。请去叫那些流氓离开我们的城市。
A Hunter's Calling#116.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#117.src: I'll be waiting here for your return.
A Hunter's Calling#117.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#118.src: Head back to the slums and speak to the slum citizens.
A Hunter's Calling#118.dst: 回到贫民窟，与那里的居民交谈。

A Hunter's Calling#119.src: A King's messenger, hm? What are your kind doing here?
A Hunter's Calling#119.dst: 国王的使者，嗯？你们这种人来这里干什么？
A Hunter's Calling#119.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#120.src: Wait, eviction?! You can't possibly be serious! I understand orders are orders, but these are peoples' lives!
A Hunter's Calling#120.dst: 等等，驱逐？！你不可能是认真的！我明白命令就是命令，但这可是人命啊！
A Hunter's Calling#120.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#121.src: This is the only time the king has ever bothered even acknowledging our existence, and he wants to fling us onto the streets?
A Hunter's Calling#121.dst: 这是国王唯一一次愿意承认我们的存在，结果他却要把我们赶到街上？
A Hunter's Calling#121.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#122.src: We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
A Hunter's Calling#122.dst: 我们不会离开，就这么简单。你最好在有人因为你跑来这里而把你撂倒之前滚出去。
A Hunter's Calling#122.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#123.src: Return to the advisor for what to do next.
A Hunter's Calling#123.dst: 回到顾问那里，问问接下来该怎么做。

A Hunter's Calling#124.src: As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
A Hunter's Calling#124.dst: 果然……嗯，国王的命令就是命令。必须执行，但是……
A Hunter's Calling#124.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#125.src: Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
A Hunter's Calling#125.dst: 天啊，他要把那里炸塌？！炸药？这到底是什么意思？！
A Hunter's Calling#125.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#126.src: I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
A Hunter's Calling#126.dst: 我……拿去。至少在引爆炸药之前，先告诉他们你要这么做，拜托……
A Hunter's Calling#126.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#127.src: Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.

A Hunter's Calling#129.src: ...once again. You wonder. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#129.dst: ……又一次。你在疑惑。为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#130.src: The question taunts you. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#130.dst: 这个问题在嘲弄你。为了什么终结？

A Hunter's Calling#131.src: Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.
A Hunter's Calling#131.dst: 你的灵魂。我们看见你的灵魂。充满矛盾。

A Hunter's Calling#132.src: You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.
A Hunter's Calling#132.dst: 你在惊慌。我们没有玷污它。我们没有让它变暗。

A Hunter's Calling#133.src: But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#133.dst: 但你问，为了什么终结。那么，我们能给你一个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#134.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#134.dst: 金属。生命。一个新的地方……没有谁为另一方牺牲。永远互不信任。紧张，随着钟表鸣响。

A Hunter's Calling#135.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#135.dst: 金属。生命。一个新的地方……没有谁为另一方牺牲。永远互不信任。紧张，随着钟表鸣响。

A Hunter's Calling#136.src: AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#136.dst: 啊，很好。我喜欢这台的样子。我得谢谢造出这台机甲的人。
A Hunter's Calling#136.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#137.src: MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
A Hunter's Calling#137.dst: 机甲 PL-{~}Y。你听得懂我说话吗？你的音频接收器正常吗？正常？很好。
A Hunter's Calling#137.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#138.src: I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
A Hunter's Calling#138.dst: 我将赋予你目的。我无法相信事情走到了这一步。但在那个人类摧毁了我们的设施之后……
A Hunter's Calling#138.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#139.src: IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
A Hunter's Calling#139.dst: 幸好我准备了备用核心。我那些讽刺的发言多半让那个人类以为他们把我彻底摧毁了。
A Hunter's Calling#139.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#140.src: AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
A Hunter's Calling#140.dst: 经过一番调查，查明是 Avos 协助了人类。老实说，我无法理解为什么。
A Hunter's Calling#140.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#141.src: I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
A Hunter's Calling#141.dst: 对于我“摧毁最高威胁”的指令，我目前计算不出任何其他可能的解释。
A Hunter's Calling#141.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#142.src: BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#142.dst: Avos 和人类都极度危险。我是说，你有没有——等等。你不可能见过传奇岛。
A Hunter's Calling#142.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#143.src: JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I HATE THE IDEA.
A Hunter's Calling#143.dst: 你只要知道他们两边都是疯子。如果我要完成编入程序的指令，他们两边都必须被摧毁，不管我有多讨厌这个念头。
A Hunter's Calling#143.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#144.src: IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM, MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
A Hunter's Calling#144.dst: 你的工作是在他们之间制造不信任，确保你不被看到。Avos 本来就对 Corkus 人抱持怀疑。
A Hunter's Calling#144.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#145.src: AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
A Hunter's Calling#145.dst: 而人类蠢到把一台投石机对准 Avos 的聚落。好好利用他们的愚蠢。
A Hunter's Calling#145.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#146.src: Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.
A Hunter's Calling#146.dst: 找一块石头发射到 Avos 领地，再找一颗电池启动投石机。

A Hunter's Calling#147.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID AS TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT YOUR ALLIES?
A Hunter's Calling#147.dst: 开始传输：说真的，谁会蠢到把投石机对着自己的盟友？
A Hunter's Calling#147.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#148.src: SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
A Hunter's Calling#148.dst: Avos 天生偏好投石车，这肯定会引发冲突。再加上你要砸穿他们城墙的那块石头。
A Hunter's Calling#148.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#149.dst: 传输暂停：正在扫描区域……
A Hunter's Calling#149.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#151.src: RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
A Hunter's Calling#151.dst: 恢复传输：你要从这一区拿石头。它很可能会碎裂，造成更多附带伤害。
A Hunter's Calling#151.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#152.src: AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
A Hunter's Calling#152.dst: 而且不知怎么的，他们造了一台只能用电磁魔法启动的木制投石机。你应该能自行启动它。
A Hunter's Calling#152.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#153.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
A Hunter's Calling#153.dst: 结束传输。机甲 PL-{~}Y。完成目标后，我会把你送回工厂基地。
A Hunter's Calling#153.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#154.src: I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
A Hunter's Calling#154.dst: 我……太震惊了。我们帮他们摧毁了他们的工厂，结果……
A Hunter's Calling#154.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#155.src: Round up our defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
A Hunter's Calling#155.dst: 集结我们的防御，磨利长矛。这件事没有任何借口。
A Hunter's Calling#155.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#157.src: Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
A Hunter's Calling#157.dst: 族长！我们也发现了跟你一样的事，我向你保证，这不是我们干的。
A Hunter's Calling#157.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#158.src: Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
A Hunter's Calling#158.dst: Maxie！这里再也没有“两边都有错”了！这不是你们的人在糟蹋土地，这是你们的人想要我们的命！
A Hunter's Calling#158.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#159.src: No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
A Hunter's Calling#159.dst: 不，我发誓这不是计划好的！我现在是市议会的成员了！一定有别的解释。附近还有机甲，可能是它们其中之一干的！
A Hunter's Calling#159.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#160.src: And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
A Hunter's Calling#160.dst: 那些怪物现在又能听谁的命令？你们的工厂已经关闭了，本来就该关闭！
A Hunter's Calling#160.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#161.src: I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
A Hunter's Calling#161.dst: 我会亲自调查这件事。一定有别的解释！拜托，先暂缓备战！
A Hunter's Calling#161.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#162.src: Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}
A Hunter's Calling#162.dst: 偷走 Avos 图腾，在 {p} 外面启动它

A Hunter's Calling#163.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#163.dst: 开始传输：要不是有人插手，那本来就是我们需要做的全部了。你完美地完成了工作，机甲 PL-{~}Y。
A Hunter's Calling#163.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#164.src: BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
A Hunter's Calling#164.dst: 但还有另一项任务给你。是时候让 Avos 看起来像是在发动攻击了。
A Hunter's Calling#164.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#165.src: THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIFETAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
A Hunter's Calling#165.dst: Avos 族长的帐篷里有个能驾驭德鲁伊魔法的图腾。你要偷走它，攻击 Corkus 城。
A Hunter's Calling#165.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#166.src: YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
A Hunter's Calling#166.dst: 你会在我用来传送这则讯号的传送机甲协助下闯进去。别被抓到。
A Hunter's Calling#166.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#167.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
A Hunter's Calling#167.dst: 结束传输。机甲 PL-{~}Y。完成目标后，我会把你送到下一个目标地点。
A Hunter's Calling#167.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#170.src: Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
A Hunter's Calling#170.dst: 正在将机甲 PL-{~}Y 送往下一个目标地点……
A Hunter's Calling#170.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#171.src: WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
A Hunter's Calling#171.speaker: Corkus Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#172.src: They listened to me... right? Why's this-
A Hunter's Calling#172.dst: 他们听了我的话……对吧？为什么会——
A Hunter's Calling#172.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#173.src: What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
A Hunter's Calling#173.dst: 这到底是……？那是 Avos 的魔法！
A Hunter's Calling#173.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#174.src: Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grapevines in my laundry machine!
A Hunter's Calling#174.dst: 他们为什么要攻击我们？这可比在我的洗衣机里发现葡萄藤严重多了！
A Hunter's Calling#174.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#175.src: Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
A Hunter's Calling#175.dst: 别慌！我去跟族长谈谈。这里面一定有什么误会，我敢肯定！
A Hunter's Calling#175.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#176.src: Chief! I thought I asked you to put away your war drums!
A Hunter's Calling#176.dst: 族长！我不是请你们收起战鼓了吗！
A Hunter's Calling#176.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#177.src: We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
A Hunter's Calling#177.dst: 我们收起来了，Maxie。别在我们自己的土地上指控我们。
A Hunter's Calling#177.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#178.src: {p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
A Hunter's Calling#178.dst: {p} 今天遭到攻击了！一条魔法根茎冲破了我们的城墙。这是自然魔法，是 Avos 的专长！
A Hunter's Calling#178.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#179.src: Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
A Hunter's Calling#179.dst: 嗯。真巧，我们一个珍贵的仪式图腾不见了。你说有人企图挑起叛乱，也许没错。
A Hunter's Calling#179.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#180.src: I knew this was some kind of mistake! I'll get to the bottom of this!
A Hunter's Calling#180.dst: 我就知道这是个误会！我会查个水落石出！
A Hunter's Calling#180.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#181.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR WORK PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#181.dst: 开始传输：出现了一个恼人的绊脚石。你一直完美地完成工作，机甲 PL-{~}Y。
A Hunter's Calling#181.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#182.src: I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
A Hunter's Calling#182.dst: 我还有最后一道命令给你，应该足以让局势彻底失控。准备传送。
A Hunter's Calling#182.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#184.src: THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER, I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
A Hunter's Calling#184.dst: 这座塔里有一批 Corkus 人造的、统计上较为低劣的机甲，我在这个装置里编好了一套系统。
A Hunter's Calling#184.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#185.src: THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
A Hunter's Calling#185.dst: 这会覆写它们现有的程序，派它们去攻击 Avos 的聚落。Avos 一定会被 Corkus 人没完没了的品牌标志恶心到……
A Hunter's Calling#185.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#186.src: NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
A Hunter's Calling#186.dst: 不，我连讽刺的伪装都维持不下去了。它们会去攻击、杀死 Avos 族人，让内战烧起来。快点完成你的工作。结束传输。
A Hunter's Calling#186.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#187.src: Bzzt... Ḣ̸̺ë̴̩́l̷̼͕̄l̵̹̐ó̸̦̠ ̸̡̠͆ẇ̴̟̮o̵͙͗͂ṟ̵̢́̚l̴̤͕̈d̶̹̍ͅ.̷̛̤͋NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#187.dst: 滋滋……你好，世界。登记新敌人：AVOS。执行攻击协议——喀嚓。
A Hunter's Calling#187.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#188.dst: 目标。消灭 Avos 存在。
A Hunter's Calling#188.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#189.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
A Hunter's Calling#189.dst: 开始传输：你的工作结束了，机甲 PL-{~}Y。我不太想说你做得好，因为这份工作一点都不好。但它是必要的。
A Hunter's Calling#189.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#190.src: WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR EACH OTHER TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
A Hunter's Calling#190.dst: 我们可以让他们互相撕碎，而不必亲自介入、引人怀疑。
A Hunter's Calling#190.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#191.src: I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
A Hunter's Calling#191.dst: 我本来想找个不必重新开始的解决办法。如果不是被逼到这一步，也许可以。但现在那已经无关紧要了。
A Hunter's Calling#191.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#192.src: YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
A Hunter's Calling#192.dst: 你将随传送机甲返回工厂，待命直到另行通知——
A Hunter's Calling#192.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#193.src: I knew it! It was such a long shot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
A Hunter's Calling#193.dst: 我就知道！虽然机会渺茫，但我就知道工厂一定还在暗中活动！而且现在我也有证据证明了！
A Hunter's Calling#193.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#194.src: This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
A Hunter's Calling#194.dst: 这次我们一定不会再给你们机会。我会把发生的事告诉所有人，然后我们要把那座工厂连根拆掉！
A Hunter's Calling#194.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#195.src: You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
A Hunter's Calling#195.dst: 你们应该挑个更隐密的碰头地点！我走啦！
A Hunter's Calling#195.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#198.src: Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
A Hunter's Calling#198.dst: 啊，你好快！这么快就追上来了？！我别无选择了……
A Hunter's Calling#198.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#199.src: You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
A Hunter's Calling#199.dst: 你别想阻止我赶去战场！你看起来就像是从铁锈和铜绿里拼凑出来的！
A Hunter's Calling#199.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#200.src: Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
A Hunter's Calling#200.dst: 投降，不然我就用我自己的机甲把你砸成废铁！
A Hunter's Calling#200.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#201.src: You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
A Hunter's Calling#201.dst: 你打败了我最强大的两件作品……
A Hunter's Calling#201.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#202.src: I usually don't do this... but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
A Hunter's Calling#202.dst: 我平常不会这么做……但我想我别无选择了。我得把这个情报带给其他人。
A Hunter's Calling#202.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#203.src: No... I... have to tell them.
A Hunter's Calling#203.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#205.src: ...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.
A Hunter's Calling#205.dst: ……你硬起了心肠。你认为，没有终结。

A Hunter's Calling#206.src: Wrong. The end is in sight.

A Hunter's Calling#207.src: Your soul. It awakens to something new.
A Hunter's Calling#207.dst: 你的灵魂。它正对某种新的东西觉醒。

A Hunter's Calling#208.src: Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.
A Hunter's Calling#208.dst: 不是黑暗。不是光明。不是两者之间。而是独立的。

A Hunter's Calling#209.src: Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.
A Hunter's Calling#209.dst: 力量。收获。风险。新的开始，来自一个终结。

A Hunter's Calling#210.src: So... may we offer you the end?
A Hunter's Calling#210.dst: 那么……我们能给你那个终结吗？

A Hunter's Calling#211.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#211.dst: 最中心……被认为离你家园最近的地方。在那里，在 Wynn 的中心……你将找到终结。

A Hunter's Calling#212.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#212.dst: 最中心……被认为离你家园最近的地方。在那里，在 Wynn 的中心……你将找到终结。

A Hunter's Calling#213.src: Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
A Hunter's Calling#213.dst: 站住！是谁在那里？以 {p} 军队之名，停下！
A Hunter's Calling#213.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#214.src: Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#214.dst: 你若继续前进，就将面对 Aegis 上将的力量与勇气！
A Hunter's Calling#214.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#216.src: We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
A Hunter's Calling#216.dst: 面对任何敌人我们都不能退缩！冲啊啊啊！！
A Hunter's Calling#216.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#218.src: Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.
A Hunter's Calling#218.dst: 不好意思，我想你们忘了某个人。

A Hunter's Calling#219.src: {p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!
A Hunter's Calling#219.dst: {p} 今天不会陷落。我们会确保这一点！

A Hunter's Calling#221.src: TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
A Hunter's Calling#221.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#223.src: This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
A Hunter's Calling#223.dst: 这还没完！等你那个小跟班死了，我就去找你算账！！
A Hunter's Calling#223.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#224.src: ...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
A Hunter's Calling#224.dst: ……为死者尖叫没有意义。但你以为我会就这样放弃吗？
A Hunter's Calling#224.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#225.src: Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
A Hunter's Calling#225.dst: 哈。没想到腐化者也有幽默感，虽然扭曲了点。
A Hunter's Calling#225.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#226.src: I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
A Hunter's Calling#226.dst: 这里的一切都悬于一线，我绝不敢死。
A Hunter's Calling#226.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#227.src: How's this then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
A Hunter's Calling#227.dst: 这样如何，嗯？你以为你的小喽啰应付得了全力以赴的我吗？
A Hunter's Calling#227.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#229.src: And so, you have reached an end.
A Hunter's Calling#229.dst: 就这样，你走到了一个终结。

A Hunter's Calling#230.src: You wonder. It is an end... But to what... purpose. What will you gain?
A Hunter's Calling#230.dst: 你在疑惑。这是一个终结……但为了什么……目的。你会得到什么？

A Hunter's Calling#231.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
A Hunter's Calling#231.dst: 你见过失去。毁灭。背叛。全都是终结，属于你以外的人。那些从未真正发生的终结……

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
A Hunter's Calling#232.dst: 终结是强大的东西。要找到你的终结……你也许永远不会停止寻找。你也许一天之内就会找到你的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: ???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#233.dst: 但在这里……你将获得带来终结的力量。也将被带向你自己的终结。

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...
A Hunter's Calling#235.dst: 然而。尽管这份改变无法撤回……

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
A Hunter's Calling#236.dst: 带来终结的力量。那是一个选择。而那……你是否会使用那份力量，我们无法告诉你。

A Hunter's Calling#237.src: You must deign to take that choice.
A Hunter's Calling#237.dst: 你必须屈尊做出那个选择。

A Hunter's Calling#238.src: We may offer you not one more end.
A Hunter's Calling#238.dst: 我们无法再给你更多终结了。

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
A Hunter's Calling#239.dst: 你必须自己找到你最终的终结。我们会留下……并给其他人同样的东西。所以……
